powers.text: It clanks to life as a lobster-shaped submersible. (No other effect in the game.)

summary: A sealed iron barrel that becomes a lobster-shaped submersible vehicle.
text: At first glance it is a sealed iron barrel, Large and weighing 500 pounds. A hidden catch (spotting it takes a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check) releases a hatch at one end so that two creatures of Medium size or smaller can climb in. Ten levers line the far end, each resting at a neutral middle setting and able to be pushed up or pulled down. Working the right levers reshapes the apparatus into a giant lobster, tail, legs, claws and all. Here it serves as an underwater vehicle; no lake in Barovia is big enough to need it.
